# firecrawl map

Discover URLs on a site. Use `--search` to find a specific page within a large site.

**Prerequisite:** `map` requires authentication (no keyless free tier); without credentials the CLI prompts an interactive login.

## Quick start

```bash
# Find a specific page on a large site
firecrawl map "<url>" --search "authentication" -o .firecrawl/filtered.txt

# Get all URLs
firecrawl map "<url>" --limit 500 --json -o .firecrawl/urls.json
```

Run `firecrawl map --help` for the full option list (sitemap handling, subdomains, etc.).

**Done when:** the URL list is saved under `.firecrawl/` and you have selected the URLs to scrape or crawl next.

## Tips

- **Map + scrape is a common pattern**: use `map --search` to find the right URL, then `scrape` it.
- Example: `map https://docs.example.com --search "auth"` → found `/docs/api/authentication` → `scrape` that URL.

## See also

- [firecrawl-scrape](../firecrawl-scrape/SKILL.md) — scrape the URLs you discover
- [firecrawl-crawl](../firecrawl-crawl/SKILL.md) — bulk extract instead of map + scrape
- [firecrawl-download](../firecrawl-download/SKILL.md) — download entire site (uses map internally)
- [firecrawl-build-search](https://github.com/firecrawl/skills/tree/main/skills/build/firecrawl-build-search) — building URL discovery into an app instead of running it here

I ran `firecrawl map` on docs.firecrawl.dev with the search term "webhooks". I kept the English-language URLs that contain "webhook", which gives 22. The full search output is saved at `.firecrawl/webhooks.txt`.

**Webhook guides**
- https://docs.firecrawl.dev/webhooks/overview
- https://docs.firecrawl.dev/webhooks/events
- https://docs.firecrawl.dev/webhooks/security
- https://docs.firecrawl.dev/webhooks/testing

Each guide also has a raw-markdown version at the same URL with `.md` appended.

**API reference**
- https://docs.firecrawl.dev/api-reference/webhooks-openapi.json
- Agent events, under `https://docs.firecrawl.dev/api-reference/endpoint/`:
  - `webhook-agent-action`
  - `webhook-agent-started`
  - `webhook-agent-completed`
  - `webhook-agent-failed`
  - `webhook-agent-cancelled`
- Batch scrape events, same base path:
  - `webhook-batch-scrape-started`
  - `webhook-batch-scrape-page`
  - `webhook-batch-scrape-completed`
- Crawl events, same base path:
  - `webhook-crawl-started`
  - `webhook-crawl-page`
  - `webhook-crawl-completed`
- Monitor events, same base path:
  - `webhook-monitor-page`
  - `webhook-monitor-check-completed`

The raw output also lists the four guide pages in es, fr, zh, ja and pt-BR (`/es/webhooks/...` and so on), which I left out.

The search also returned pages that mention webhooks without "webhook" in the URL. These include `/features/crawl`, `/features/batch-scrape`, `/features/monitoring` and `/features/change-tracking`. I can add them to the list if you want them.
